📍 En une phrase

Off Grid AI est une application gratuite, open source et multiplateforme (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows) de Wednesday Solutions, Inc. qui exécute des modèles de langage GGUF, des modèles d'image Stable Diffusion et la transcription vocale Whisper entièrement sur l'appareil, avec plus de 180 000 téléchargements cumulés et plus de 3 000 étoiles GitHub, mais seulement 26 avis sur l'App Store.

💬 En termes simples

Voyez-la comme une alternative gratuite et open source à un chatbot IA par abonnement — vous l'installez sur votre téléphone, tablette, Mac ou PC, téléchargez un modèle une fois, et tout ce qui suit tourne sur votre propre matériel, sans compte et sans internet nécessaire pour discuter.

## Ce qu'est Off Grid AI [...] Avis Private LLM — une alternative payante, closed source, Apple uniquement, avec 140+ modèles organisés.

Avis PocketPal AI — une alternative gratuite, open source, mobile uniquement.

Avis Enclave AI — une autre application mobile locale gratuite pour comparer les bibliothèques de modèles.

Avis Loci AI — une alternative multiplateforme organisée et à faible friction.

← Retour aux LLM locaux avancés

results.content:
And now, I will include some thoughts from here on.

## Future Trends in Offline AI 2026: The Era Where 'Your Own AI' on a Single Smartphone Becomes the Standard

As of 2026, offline AI (fully local AI, on-device AI, edge AI) is no longer an 'alternative' but is rapidly growing as the mainstream trend in AI.

As the limitations of cloud dependency (latency, privacy leaks, power consumption, and data sovereignty issues) are exposed, the era of full-scale generative AI running offline on smartphones, PCs, and wearables is becoming a reality due to dramatic hardware advancements and model optimization.

Fully local apps like Off Grid are accelerating this trend.  
The main future trends are summarized below.

### 1. Hardware Revolution: NPUs Evolve Explosively as 'AI-Dedicated Brains' [...] ## What kind of problems does Off Grid solve?

The biggest problems Off Grid solves are 'cloud AI privacy issues' and 'internet dependency'.

Cloud services like ChatGPT and Gemini are convenient, but conversation content may be saved on servers and used as training data.

Because Off Grid does not send any data externally, you can handle sensitive information (diaries, business ideas, medical consultations, etc.) with peace of mind. It is ideal for use in hospitals, companies, and for privacy-conscious users.

It also resolves the inconvenience of 'not being able to use AI when there is no internet'. [...] ### 5. Other Notable Competitors

 Haplo AI / Apollo AI / Solair AI: Lightweight, iOS-centric apps. Their selling point is easy model downloading and offline chat, but features are text-focused.
 Google AI Edge Gallery: Google's official demo/experimental app. A Proof of Concept utilizing MLC and MediaPipe. Feature-rich but not as polished as Off Grid.
 SmolChat-Android / ChatterUI: Lightweight apps specialized for Android. Simple, but not as feature-rich as Off Grid.

## Detailed Benchmark Comparison of Off Grid Competitor Apps (As of April 2026)

The performance of fully local smartphone AI apps varies significantly depending on device specs (SoC, RAM, NPU/GPU), model size and quantization level used, and the inference engine (llama.cpp, MLX, MLC, etc.).

results.title: Off-Grid Data Centers: A Potential Power Solution For AI - Troutman Pepper Locke
results.content:
Data center developers and operators are frequently looking to remote locations such as West Texas where there is access to gas and fewer people thereby avoiding the need to manage community reactions to their projects as this potential transformation of the U.S. grid takes shape.

#### Alternative On-Site Solutions

Other technology solutions to pair energy generation with AI processing facilities could also ease pressure on the grid. One is from Rune, which set up in 2023 to roll out modular data centers that can fit within the footprint of an existing solar or wind farm, and are powered with only the excess electricity generated by that facility. This is a different approach from huge power-hungry, always-on data centers, and one that could also bolster grid stability. [...] Decentralized Access to Technology Alternatives Act of 2026: The DATA Act was introduced to the Senate on January 7, 2026, with a proposal to exempt private off-grid electricity facilities, including those supplying data centers, from regulation by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) and Department of Energy (DOE). It would amend the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978 and Public Utility Holding Company Act of 2005, and clarify that off-grid data centers do not have to follow the North American Electric Reliability Corporation’s Reliability Standards. Its goal is to help operators avoid the costs associated with compliance. [...] “We’re seeing this increased demand for it because the grid-tied interconnect queue is congested and this alternative may provide a way to bypass it,” she said. “We’re going to see this demand for off-grid projects because the juice is now worth the squeeze.”

Yates said typically off-grid data centers are more complex to deliver than grid-connected cousins because companies need power-engineering expertise to develop a reliable system. She said the concept had not yet achieved critical mass but there is early adoption: “I think it’ll gain increased popularity as ERCOT refines its large-load interconnection process and promulgates final rules over the course of 2026.”
